topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Ongoing fees or expenses are charges you pay regularly, such as an annual account maintenance fee, even if there are no transactions in your account.
question: Misconception: I only pay investment fees when I buy, sell, or exchange an investment.
answer: Transaction fees are charged when you buy, sell, or exchange an investment. But ongoing fees are different: you may pay them regularly, even when no transactions occur. Both types of fees reduce the amount of money in your investment portfolio.
